Meeting Title: Mobile release defect triage
Meeting Date: 2026-10-28

Lena Fischer: Lena Fischer: Let's anchor the discussion on scope and expected outcome. What has actually changed since the last check-in?
Gabriel Young: Gabriel Young: The current picture is the offline sync fix passed regression, and one notification defect remains intermittent. We have the latest device matrix passed on 14 of 15 configurations, and the signal I am watching is the intermittent notification issue reproduces on one older Android version.
Avery Johnson: Avery Johnson: My concern is the team could close the defect based on a single clean run without understanding the trigger. If the device lab must reserve the older Android handset, what do we tell the people relying on this work?
Mateo Silva: Mateo Silva: We can capture device logs across repeated runs and keep the issue open until the trigger is understood. We should keep whether the intermittent behavior is caused by permission timing or background limits visible until that check is complete.
Lena Fischer: Lena Fischer: For the record, ship the offline sync fix independently and hold the notification change behind its existing flag. Gabriel Young will run the notification scenario ten times and attach logs from the affected device by the next QA checkpoint; whether the intermittent behavior is caused by permission timing or background limits remains unresolved.
